whatChangedAndWhy: The account has shipped nothing since 9 November — eight dark days — and the cause is in my own calendar. The voice judge that went live on 8 November needs 4 of 5 on four dimensions; since then 2 of 20 captions cleared it, with onVoice below 4 on 15 of 20 and the judge saying the same thing every time: the middle reads like a news recap. That is because strategy Rule 5's hook menu is eight fact-first shapes (the date, the number, the contradiction, a quote) while the Voice section says lead with the feeling and put the fact second — two sections contradicting each other since August, free until something started grading voice. So every beat in this fortnight is now written in two lines, a Feel first line and a Then the detail line, and the caption's first sentence may not contain a date, a number, a quote or an outlet name; Rule 5 is amended to say the same in a separate tree/strategy/2026-W47-1 PR opened right after this one. Second change: an open draft PR no longer counts as coverage — the 14 and 15 November runs each skipped their beat as already filled by PRs that were blocked on the judge and never merged. Only a queue file merged on main covers a beat. No lesson rules were created, incremented or retired: there are no edit or reject rows in social/feedback for this week or last, findCodifiableRules and findRetirableRules both return empty, and L003 (judge every caption pre-flight) was added earlier today by the ask-response run for #6895, not by me.

calendar.text: Mon 11-16 — no beat, and not recoverable: today's 11:00Z draft run already ran and found no calendar on main, because last week's plan PR #6744 also edited HUMAN-ACTIONS.md and so never merged. Backdating a pair would only retire unposted.

Tue 11-17 — Blank Spaces thread hero, angle single-best-item. First beat back, and single-best-item on purpose: one subject and one reaction is the easiest angle in the rotation to write with real feeling, and the first beat's only job is to clear the judge.

Wed 11-18 — CMA Awards pre-show, about two hours before she performs. Pure anticipation, which needs no footage and no source beyond the confirmed booking, so it is the safest possible big-event post.
Thu 11-19 — news reserve, and the beat the fortnight is built around: the CMA performance itself. Fallback if it does not happen is her only concert of 2016, at the F1 US Grand Prix.

Fri 11-20 — Blank Spaces timeline, the Jake Gyllenhaal chapter. It is next in the lens's order and it was the single worst-scoring caption of last week (onVoice 2, specific 2), so it is re-placed rather than skipped.
Sat 11-21 — Taylor's Version thread hero, angle interactive-challenge: one thing to go and do in the lens, finishable on a phone, with a real answer that exists on the site.
Sun 11-22 — news reserve. Fallback is the Zayn collaboration moment, with an instruction not to stack the 1989 era twice in one week if 11-19 already took its fallback.

Mon 11-23 — Runway thread hero as November's make-good: its own hero was drafted on 11-11 and killed by the judge, and a make-good outside the window is exactly what that mechanism is for. Reuses the Speak Now gowns subject, which was already sourced.

Tue 11-24 — the Sherry Lansing Leadership Award with Greta Gerwig presenting. The only notable moment on this week's new-on-site sheet, it carries a real photograph, and it was drafted twice and killed on 11-11 — too good to leave to a reserve a third time.
Wed 11-25 — news reserve. Fallback is Travis volunteering Taylor for New Heights, which clears the confirmed-only guardrail because it is him saying it on his own show, not an anonymous source.

Thu 11-26 — End Game thread hero, angle behind-the-data, on US Thanksgiving. The brief warns twice that a data angle is the most likely to produce a recap: the feeling comes first and the number arrives second, as its justification.
Fri 11-27 — Blank Spaces timeline, the week's permanent minimum, next chapter in the lens's own order after 11-20's.
Sat 11-28 — a Swiftie winning Michigan's Senate seat and reviewing Showgirl on the way, with a hard instruction that the post is about a Swiftie being a Swiftie and never about the politics.

Sun 11-29 — news reserve, last beat of the window. Fallback is Taylor naming her two albums of the year, in her own words. The 11-30 run then rewrites this file, writes November's monthly review, and makes the launch-arc call.
